# Ezekiel 5 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** "Now, son of man, take a sharp sword and use it like a barber's razor to shave your head and beard. Then get a set of scales and divide the hair into three equal piles.

**2** When the siege in your model ends, burn a third of the hair inside the city you drew. Take another third and chop it with the sword all around the city. Scatter the last third to the wind — and I will chase them with a drawn sword.

**3** But save a few strands and tuck them into your robe.

**4** Then take some of those saved strands and throw them into the fire and burn them. From this fire, flames will spread to the whole house of Israel."

**5** This is what the Lord GOD says: "This is Jerusalem — I placed her at the center of the nations, surrounded by countries on every side.

**6** But she rebelled against My commands and laws more wickedly than any of the nations around her. She rejected My rules and refused to follow My ways."

**7** Therefore the Lord GOD says: "You have been more unruly than the nations around you. You haven't followed My laws. You haven't even lived up to the standards of the nations around you."

**8** So the Lord GOD says: "I Myself am now against you. I will carry out My judgment against you while the whole world watches.

**9** Because of your disgusting practices, I will do things to you that I have never done before and will never do again.

**10** Parents will eat their own children in your streets, and children will eat their parents. I will punish you and scatter your survivors to the four winds.

**11** I will cut you down without pity or compassion because of all your disgusting sins, declares the Lord GOD.

**12** I will cut you down without pity or compassion because of all your disgusting sins, declares the Lord GOD.

**13** I will cut you down without pity or compassion because of all your disgusting sins, declares the Lord GOD.

**14** I will cut you down without pity or compassion because of all your disgusting sins, declares the Lord GOD.

**15** You will become an object of mockery, scorn, warning, and horror to all the nations around you when I pour out My anger and fury on you with devastating punishments. I, the LORD, have spoken.

**16** I will shoot My deadly arrows of famine at you — arrows meant to destroy. I will pile famine on top of famine and cut off your food supply completely.

**17** I will send famine and wild animals to ravage you and rob you of your children. Disease and bloodshed will sweep through you, and I will bring war against you. I, the LORD, have spoken."

---
## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

- **5:1-4**: Shaving your head and beard was deeply shameful in the ancient world. Then burning, chopping, and scattering the hair — God is asking Ezekiel to act out Jerusalem's total humiliation on his own body.

- **5:5-6**: The shocking claim: Jerusalem is worse than the pagan nations around her. Not just failing to meet God's standards — failing to meet even basic human decency. Privilege without faithfulness becomes the worst kind of guilt.

- **5:10**: This verse is almost unbearable — parents eating their children during siege. It's not metaphor. It's the reality of what happens when a city is starved into madness. God doesn't sanitize the horror.

— PNEUMA
